type.description: Debug a Dart CLI app (dart) or a Flutter app (flutter)

label.description: Human-readable label for this debug config

args.description: Additional arguments passed to flutter/dart run

device_id.description: Target device ID. Use a platform name ("ios", "android", "macos", "chrome") or a specific device ID from `flutter devices`. If omitted, Flutter's debug adapter picks the device automatically.

platform.description: Target platform override passed to the debug adapter. Usually inferred automatically; only set if you need to force a specific value.

useFvm.description: Use fvm to resolve the Flutter SDK version

vmServiceUri.description: VM Service URI for attach mode (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:12345/...)

debugSdkLibraries.description: Whether to enable debugging of Dart SDK libraries

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Whether to enable debugging of external package libraries

additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the flutter/dart tool (e.g. --dart-define=KEY=VALUE)

webRenderer.description: Web renderer to use for Flutter web builds
